dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: The Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland is so much fun, and there are loads of cute little animals. Come on, take a break from those horror films already.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: *yawn* I'm delighted to hear that you've been enjoying yourself, but I need to concentrate on this film for now. Those animal assistants will have to wait...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I just need a little... more sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ugh... Every time I close my eyes, I keep thinking of new tricks. So tired... Can't sleep, but can't get up either...

choices.text: Then why don't you come out and have a walk?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, Lyney! A change of pace should stop your mind from wandering!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two are here as well!?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: They're the managers of the park, and I'm about to become a consultant for one of the attractions too.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: In that case, count me in! Not just for my own sake, of course, but to support my friends!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Just give me a moment to freshen up...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: #If there's one person Lyney can't say no to, it's you, {NICKNAME}. You're in a league all of your own.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: I'm not exactly sure how long my brother meant by "a moment"... So why don't we meet back up at the venue?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good! Getting Lyney to cheer up and visit the amusement park's surely our greatest success yet!

choices.text: There'll be cute animals to play with...
